summary: HIVE Digital Technologies Ltd. filed an 8-K regarding a non-binding letter of intent (Boden LOI) with a Swedish technology company for an 8-to-10 year co-location lease of its 32 MW facility in Boden, Sweden, covering about 25 MW of critical IT load. The LOI is subject to negotiation of a definitive agreement; no financial terms are disclosed. This is a commercial lease arrangement, not a transformative corporate event. Regulation FD disclosure accompanies the announcement. Watch for execution of a definitive agreement, but there is no risk-arb angle as no securities or structural change is involved.
